<p><b>Autosomal</b> (atDNA) : les 22 pai:
Autosomal (atDNA): the 22 pairs of non-sex chromosomes, received half from each parent. It finds cousins on all sides back to about 5 to 8 generations. It is the most common “genealogy” test.

Y-DNA: passed from father to son almost unchanged. It follows a single line, often the surname line, over hundreds of years. It is studied through its markers (Y-STR: 37, 67, 111 markers…) and its mutations (SNPs), which give the haplogroup.

Mitochondrial DNA (mtDNA): passed by the mother to all her children; only daughters pass it on. Very stable: useful for old questions or to tell two maternal lines apart.

X-DNA: its special way of being passed on rules out some ancestors (see “Y, mt and X lines”).
<p>Dans un village isolé, une île, une c: In an isolated village, an island or a closed community, you descend several times from the same ancestors (pedigree collapse). You then share more DNA than expected, in many small segments: relationships look closer than they are. Be wary of the estimates; look at the longest segment.
<p>Le <b>centimorgan</b> mesure une long: The centimorgan measures a “genetic” length of DNA. You share about 3,400 to 3,700 cM with a parent, 850 on average with a first cousin, 230 with a second cousin… The total and the length of the longest segment help guess the relationship (“📐 Calculator”). Small segments (under 7 to 8 cM) are often “noise” or very old.
<p>Mise au point par Dana Leeds : on pre: Devised by Dana Leeds: take the matches from 90 to 400 cM (2nd and 3rd cousins) and colour together those that match each other. You often get 4 groups (your 4 grandparents) or 8 (your great-grandparents). You need to note each one’s “shared matches” (“🗂️ Groups”).
<p>Si A correspond avec toi, B correspon: If A matches you, B matches you, and A and B match each other on the same segment, that segment very probably comes from an ancestor shared by all three. It is the best genetic proof of a branch. The “🧩 chromosome browser” shows the overlaps to check.
<p>Un <b>haplogroupe</b> (R-M269, I-M253: A haplogroup (R-M269, I-M253, H1, U5b…) gathers everyone descended from the same distant ancestor in the Y or mt line, often thousands of years ago. Two people in the same haplogroup are not necessarily close: you need fine subclades or a marker match.

Chaque bougie : la 1re et la dernière an: Each candle: the first and last year of the decade, the lowest and the highest year
Chaque branche a sa couleur (onglet « 📊: Each branch has its colour (“📊 Figures” tab to change it).
Chaque carte piochée va sur l’un des 8 t: Each card drawn goes on one of the 8 waiting piles; only the Aces go up at once. When the stock is empty, the top cards of the piles go up, one by one in suit.
Chaque carte piochée va sur une fondatio: Each card drawn goes on a foundation or on one of the 4 waiting piles. The foundations start with an Ace and go up one by one, regardless of suit.
Chaque case reçoit un ancêtre et se colo: Each box gets an ancestor and is coloured by what you choose. Empty boxes are ancestors not found yet.
Chaque choix se change ici ; l’option co: Every choice can be changed here; the recommended option is the starting one.
Chaque choix se voit : clique, l’aperçu: Every choice shows: click, the preview follows. For the tools Charts, Map, Investigations, Research, People, Lists, Settings…
Chaque cœur ramassé coûte 1 point, la Da: Each heart taken costs 1 point, the Queen of spades 13 points. You can’t lead a heart until a heart has been played. On the first trick, no hearts or Queen of spades if you have something else.
Chaque colline à sa hauteur: Each hill at its own height
Chaque contrat rangé retient la version: Each filed contract keeps the version used.
Chaque correspondance se place sur la rè: Each match is placed on the ruler by its shared cM; hover over a dot to see possible relationships.
Chaque couple : le mariage (date, lieu),: Each couple: the marriage (date, place), the children, a separation, the sources.
Chaque couple est un point : sa distance: Each couple is a dot: its distance from the centre is the distance between the spouses’ birthplaces.
Chaque courrier va dans le Registre de c: Each letter goes into the Letter register, with its reminder.
Chaque département applique ce cadre ave: Each department applies this scheme with its own sub-series and numbering: notaries are in 3 E here, in 5 E elsewhere; civil registers may be in E, in E-dépôt, or viewable on microfilm (Mi). Some series do not exist everywhere.
chaque département grossi selon le nombr: each département enlarged by the number of ancestors
Chaque dossier a sa propre base (« ⚖️ 20: Each file has its own database (“⚖️ 2026-014 MAZAUD”). The most watertight; best kept for large estates.
Chaque éclipse de Soleil ou de Lune visi: Each solar or lunar eclipse visible from the places where your family members lived, during their lifetime: who saw it, from where, and how much. Everything is calculated (after Jean Meeus), without downloading anything.
Chaque écran est un bouton au-dessus de: Each screen is a button above the preview, and a “Screen” choice when you style an element: its styles go into its {code} block in the site’s CSS.
Chaque élément devient une <b>référence<: Each item becomes a project reference (authors, magazine, issue, pages or timing, summary, tags, captures); a passage to remember or what is said also becomes a quote.
Chaque enfant devient une case sous son: Each child becomes a box under its parent; its width = the number of its descendants (the person included). A click on a box opens the record.
Chaque enfant devient une part de son pa: Each child becomes a part of its parent; the size of a part = the number of descendants (the person included).
Chaque enfant né (ou baptisé) avec une d: Each child born (or baptised) with a date: died before 1, before 5, or later. Those whose death is unknown are left out.
Chaque énigme porte sur un ancêtre ; cha: Each riddle is about an ancestor; each answer points to a hiding place: you need the right answer to find what comes next.
Chaque époque de la maison (🕰) devient u: Each period of the house (🕰) becomes a shot, one after the other, with a fade.
Chaque étape est facultative et se défai: Each step is optional and can be undone (↶). Nothing damages the original: the restored photo becomes a new version.
Chaque événement daté qui a un lieu comp: Every dated event with a place counts. The ▶ slider goes through the decades one by one.
Chaque événement qui a un lieu devient u: Every event with a place becomes a dot (a marriage counts for each of the two spouses). Places without coordinates are looked up among French municipalities by name and département. The table is replaced.
chaque exposition est une fiche, reliée: each exhibition is a record, linked to all its works
Chaque fiche aux couleurs de son temps :: Each record in the colours of its time: parchment, sepia, Belle Époque, art deco, post-war boom.
Chaque fiche rassemble l’identité, les r: Each record gathers identity, family relationships, events, media, censuses, sources, notes, signatures, linked investigations and exports. Blocks can be reordered, hidden and resized.
Chaque fois qu’on le voit : quand, où, c: Each time it is seen: when, where, what it was doing, with whom, by whom, and whether the ring was read correctly.
Chaque fonte est une petite fiche : cach: Each cast is a small record: engraved mark and number, weight, patinator, successive owners, sales and prices, photos of the copy.
Chaque fonte est une petite fiche (cache: Each cast is a small record (mark, number, weight, patinator, owners, sales, photos).
Chaque foyer recensé avec ses membres, r: Each census household with its members, grouped by year. Click a name to open their record (the census is edited from the record, Censuses block).
Chaque gros bouton garde sa couleur part: Each big button keeps its colour everywhere: you find your way without reading.
Chaque groupe se replie. Un clic sur « R: Each group collapses. Clicking “Remaining” opens the collection status. A collection without an archive service goes under “No archive service”: “Edit” → “🏛 Where it is”.
Chaque héritier a ses actes : il en manq: Each heir has their records: some are missing for {who}.
Chaque indice a sa source (la citation :: Each piece of evidence has its source (the citation: register, year, image, record).
Chaque invité aura son lien avec elle («: Each guest will get their relationship to this person (“second cousin of …”). Usually you.
Chaque jeu de données en liste : cherche: Each data set as a list: search by year, by place, around a town, combine criteria, see them on the map.
Chaque joueur a 16 pièces. Les blancs co: Each player has 16 pieces. White starts. You win by checkmating the opposing king: it is attacked and can no longer escape.
Chaque joueur doit avoir une couleur dif: Each player must have a different colour.
Chaque jour un ancêtre en image, aux dim: An ancestor in a picture every day, sized for your screen: colours, pattern, photo, texts, calendar… everything can be set.
Chaque jour un autre ancêtre — en priori: A different ancestor every day — preferably one whose birth or death anniversary it is. Your settings are kept on this computer.
Chaque lecture (chaque modèle) est gardé: Each reading (each model) is kept: take the best of each.
Chaque lien de ta lignée s’appuie sur au: Every link in your line rests on at least one source.
Chaque lien de ta lignée s’appuie sur un: Every link in your line rests on a source, well done!
Chaque lien est prouvé par un acte: Every link is proved by a record
Chaque lieu de l’arbre a son tampon. Qua: Each place in the tree has its stamp. When you go there — the village, the church, the town hall, the cemetery — click it: “I’ve been there”.
Chaque lieu de ta base devient un rond,: Each place in your database becomes a circle, bigger when more people were born (married, died) there. Places with coordinates are placed exactly; the others are looked up by name on the map. The table is replaced.
Chaque lieu de ta base est rattaché à sa: Each place in your database is assigned to its area (by its coordinates, otherwise its département, region or country; for municipalities: its INSEE code, then its name and département), then the areas are counted. The table is replaced.
Chaque ligne devient une note, rangées e: Each line becomes a note, arranged in a grid.
Chaque ligne est lue dans l’outil d’orig: Each line is read from the original tool when you open the list, and “↗” takes you there to decide. Nothing is copied: fixing it in the tool makes the line disappear.
Chaque lignée (père, grand-père… ou pare: Each line (father, grandfather… or parents) gives a path of occupations; the occupation comes from the record or the first “Occupation” event.
Chaque maillon : combien de pièces le pr: Each link: how many documents prove it
Chaque mariage relie deux lieux : les li: Each marriage links two places: the birthplaces of both spouses, or each one’s birthplace and the place of marriage. The most frequent places keep their name, the others go into “Others”.
Chaque matin à 6 h, la partie est gardée: Every morning at 6 am the game is kept (the last {n}). Resuming takes you back to that morning; if you change your mind, “↶ Undo” brings you back to where you were.
Chaque mère sur une ligne, ses enfants à: Each mother on a line, her children at the age she was when they were born, the gap in months between two births and the children who died young.
Chaque naissance est un point : l’âge du: Each birth is a dot: the father’s age (and the mother’s) by year.
Chaque naissance est une note : plus aig: Each birth is a note: higher for recent generations, longer for a long life, softer in tone for women; each marriage a chord; each death a low note.
Chaque nom de famille : combien de perso: Each surname: how many people bear it, in which period, where, its other spellings. One click: the people with that name.
Chaque nom de famille de l’ascendance :: Each surname in the ancestry: through whom and when it enters the tree (a woman and her name), its spelling variants grouped, and how many ancestors bear it in each generation.
Every tab already has an emoji.
Chaque page a ses widgets ; les boutons: Each page has its own widgets; the page buttons are at the top of Animal tracking. The ticked page shows when it opens.
Each page has its own widgets; the page buttons are at the top of the dashboard. The ticked page shows when it opens.
Chaque pays à son heure légale d’aujourd: Each country at its legal time today (summer time included); big countries are split into regions, roughly. Hover over a country to see its time zone.
Chaque personne a sa fiche. Ce bouton en: Each person has a record. This button creates one: a first name, a surname, and off you go.
Chaque personne devient une ligne, de sa: Each person becomes a row, from birth to death (role: Man or Woman, change it as you like).
Chaque personne donne une valeur (son âg: Each person gives a value (age at death, or at marriage), sorted into a category (century, sex).
Chaque personne est une ligne qui passe: Each person is a line passing through several axes (age at marriage, children, age at death…): profiles are visible at a glance.
Chaque personne née, et pas encore morte: Everyone born, and not yet dead, in the chosen year counts in their age band. Then: the slider under the drawing changes the year, ▶ plays through time.
Chaque personne passe d’une catégorie à: Each person moves from one category to the next: the bands show how many go from where to where.
Each person moves from one category to the next. Choose 2 or 3 axes; the most frequent keep their name, the others are grouped together.
Chaque personne relie deux lieux de ta b: Each person links two places in your database (those with coordinates, or a recognised map area). The table is replaced.
Chaque photo devient une page, dans l’or: Each photo becomes a page, in order.
Chaque photo est une <b>nouvelle page</b: Each photo is a new page, one after another
Chaque photo ou document de tes médias e: Each photo or document in your media is described aloud: the “Image description” written in the media window, otherwise its title, date, place and linked people. Small images next to a name and decorations are skipped.
Chaque piste dans un fichier ({n}): Each track in its own file ({n})

Deux jeux : les As et les 2 sont posés d: Two decks: the Aces and 2s are placed in advance, and the foundations go up in twos in suit (Ace, 3, 5… or 2, 4, 6…). 9 columns; build down in twos in suit. The stock deals one card onto each column.
Deux jeux : les As sont posés d’avance,: Two decks: the Aces are placed in advance, a reserve of 14 cards and 5 columns. Build down alternating red and black; an empty column is filled from the reserve. The stock turns three cards at a time and can be gone through twice more.
Deux jeux : les huit 2 sont posés d’avan: Two decks: the eight 2s are placed in advance, and the foundations go up in suit to the Ace. 10 columns of one card; build down in suit (the Ace goes on the 2, the King on the Ace), one card at a time. The stock goes through only once.
Deux jeux : un As et un 2 de chaque coul: Two decks: an Ace and a 2 of each suit are placed in advance, and the foundations go up in twos in their suit (Ace, 3, 5… King, 2, 4… or 2, 4… Queen, Ace, 3…). 9 one-card spaces that you don’t build on; an empty space takes any card. The stock can be gone through once more.

Two decks: an Ace and a 2 of each suit are placed in advance, and the foundations go up in twos in their suit. Four reserve piles of 3 cards (only the top one is playable) and 16 one-card spaces that you don’t build on; an empty space takes any card. The stock goes through only once.
Deux jeux de cartes, 10 colonnes, 6 case: Two decks, 10 columns, 6 free cells, 8 foundations.
Deux jeux de cartes, beaucoup de colonne: Two decks, many columns, a single stock.
Deux jeux, 10 colonnes de 10 cartes visi: Two decks, 10 columns of 10 face-up cards and 4 free cells already filled; build down alternating red and black, one card at a time (or a run if the free cells allow it).
Deux jeux, 10 colonnes de 4 cartes dont: Two decks, 10 columns of 4 cards with 3 face down; build down alternating red and black. The stock goes through only once.
Deux jeux, 10 colonnes de 4 cartes visib: Two decks, 10 columns of 4 visible cards; build down in suit, one card at a time. The stock goes through only once.
Deux jeux, 10 colonnes de 5 cartes (quat: Two decks, 10 columns of 5 cards (four face down); build down alternating red and black and move whole runs. An empty column takes only a King; the stock deals one card onto each column.
Deux jeux, 10 colonnes de 5 cartes visib: Two decks, 10 columns of 5 face-up cards. Build down regardless of suit; only runs of one suit move together; a full run from King to Ace is removed. The stock deals one card onto each column that is not empty.
Deux jeux, 10 colonnes en escalier ; on: Two decks, 10 staircase columns; build down alternating red and black. The stock turns one card at a time and goes through only once.
Deux jeux, 10 colonnes, 8 fondations ; o: Two decks, 10 columns, 8 foundations; build down in suit and move any group of face-up cards.
Deux jeux, 10 colonnes, tout est distrib: Two decks, 10 columns, everything is dealt (the first five columns hide 4 cards). Build down in suit and move any group; a full run from King to Ace is removed.
Deux jeux, 10 colonnes. On descend sans: Two decks, 10 columns. Build down regardless of suit; a complete run from King to Ace is removed. The stock deals one card onto each column.
Deux jeux, 12 colonnes d’une carte ; on: Two decks, 12 columns of one card; build down in suit and move whole runs. The stock goes through only once.
Two decks, 12 columns of one card; build down in suit, one card at a time. The stock goes through only once.
Deux jeux, 12 colonnes d’une carte. On d: Two decks, 12 columns of one card. Build down in suit and move whole runs; the stock deals one card onto each column.
Deux jeux, 12 colonnes de 4 cartes visib: Two decks, 12 columns of 4 face-up cards; build down in suit and move whole runs. The stock goes through only once.
Deux jeux, 13 colonnes de 4 cartes visib: Two decks, 13 columns of 4 face-up cards; build down in suit and move whole runs. The stock goes through only once.
Deux jeux, 13 colonnes de 8 cartes toute: Two decks, 13 columns of 8 cards all visible, no stock. Build down regardless of suit; only runs of one suit move together; a complete run from King to Ace is removed.
Deux jeux, 14 colonnes de 7 cartes et 8: Two decks, 14 columns of 7 cards and 8 free cells, 6 of them already filled; build down in suit, an empty column takes only a King.
Deux jeux, 35 éventails de 3 cartes ; on: Two decks, 35 fans of 3 cards; build up or down by one rank in suit, one card at a time. An empty space stays empty.
Deux jeux, 7 colonnes de 7 cartes visibl: Two decks, 7 columns of 7 face-up cards; build down alternating red and black, one card at a time. The stock goes through only once.
Deux jeux, 7 colonnes de 7 cartes, une c: Two decks, 7 columns of 7 cards, every other one face down. Build down alternating red and black and move whole runs; an empty column takes any card. The stock goes through only once.
Deux jeux, 8 colonnes d’une carte ; la p: Two decks, 8 columns of one card; the stock deals one card onto each column. Build down alternating red and black and move whole runs; an empty column takes only a King. When the stock is empty, a free cell opens to set a card aside.
Two decks, 8 columns of one card; the stock deals one card onto each column. Build down alternating red and black and an empty column takes any card.
Deux jeux, 8 colonnes d’une carte ; on d: Two decks, 8 columns of one card; build down regardless of suit, one card at a time. The stock goes through only once.

Deux jeux, 8 colonnes de 4 cartes ; on d: Two decks, 8 columns of 4 cards; build down regardless of suit, one card at a time. The stock goes through only once.
Deux jeux, 8 colonnes de 5 cartes ; on d: Two decks, 8 columns of 5 cards; build down in suit and the stock goes through once more.
Deux jeux, 8 colonnes de 8 cartes visibl: Two decks, 8 columns of 8 face-up cards; build down alternating red and black, an empty column takes any card. The stock can be gone through twice more.
Deux jeux, 8 colonnes en escalier ; on d: Two decks, 8 staircase columns; build down alternating red and black and move whole runs. An empty column takes only a King; the stock deals one card onto each column. The foundations go up from Ace to King.

Un même haplogroupe dit un ancêtre commu: The same haplogroup means a very distant common ancestor in the direct line, not a close relationship.
Un même nom ne veut pas dire une même fa: The same name doesn’t mean the same family: it’s just for fun.
Un même nom peut être celui d’un homonym: The same name may belong to a namesake: check the text of the bell and the dates. The names in your database are searched only here, on your computer.
Un menu dans le panier pour passer de l’: A menu in the basket to switch from one to another.
Un modèle « vision » ouvert qui tourne s: An open “vision” model running on your computer (Ollama): reads difficult handwriting better, slower
Un modèle a appris à lire une sorte d’éc: A model has learned to read one kind of handwriting. They come from their official repository (zenodo.org); their licence is read at the source and the file is checked by its fingerprint before being kept.
Un modèle d’acte à compléter: A record template to fill in
A piece from the middle of a text.
Un mot de départ à gauche ; à droite, le: A starting word on the left; on the right, the words that follow it in the records, bigger when they come up often.
Un mot des actes anciens et ce qu’il veu: A word from old records and what it means.
Un mur de moins de 5 cm (un double-clic: A wall shorter than 5 cm (one double-click too many?)
A received museum can’t be edited.
Un nom commence par une lettre, sans esp: A name starts with a letter, without spaces (e.g. Total, Ages_1836).
Un nom d’autrefois en allemand, polonais: An old name in German, Polish, Czech…: today’s place, where it is, and what it belonged to.
un nom de commune mal lu ou abrégé (« St: a town name misread or abbreviated (“St” for Saint): look at the census image.
Un nom de lieu inconnu : lieux-dits et a: An unknown place name: localities and old names
Un nom fixe, une séquence 001, 002…, la: A fixed name, a sequence 001, 002…, the date, the title, the person or the place.
An unknown name in the formula.
Un nom pour {ref} (pour écrire =SOMME(To: A name for {ref} (to write =SOMME(Total) instead of =SOMME(D2:D40)):
Un nom pour la retrouver d’un clic, au-d: A name to find it again in one click, above the list.
Un nom pour retrouver cette liste filtré: A name to find this filtered list again in one click.
Un nom, un mot… (2 lettres suffisent): A name, a word… (2 letters are enough)
un nom, une commune, un métier…: a name, a town, an occupation…
Un nom, une cote, un titre: A name, a shelfmark, a title
A name, a town, a country or a year.
A number raised to a power.
Un nombre en lettres ou en chiffres: A number in words or figures (French)
Un nombre ou une date écrits avec un for: A number or date written with a format ("0,00", "0 %", "jj/mm/aaaa").
Un nombre, une part en %, ou la moyenne: A number, a share in %, or the average (median) of a value: age at death, age at marriage, number of children.
Un notaire de l’étude, facultatif: A notary from the office, optional
Un notaire qui change d’étude reste nomm: A notary who changes office stays named in their old files: set an end date, they become “former”.
Un nuage de mots : les plus fréquents éc: A word cloud: the most frequent written large.
Un numéro de puce n’a que des chiffres (: A microchip number has only digits (usually 15).
un numéro Sosa est un nombre entier qui: a Sosa number is a whole number starting at 1
Un objet à toi : nom, taille, couleur, f: An object of your own: name, size, colour, shape, image
Un objet seul s’aligne sur le plan de tr: A single object aligns with the artboard (or the page or panel it’s on). Several: with each other, or with the artboard if “Artboard” is chosen. When moving or resizing, pink guides snap to the edges and centers of other objects (⌘ or Ctrl to do without).
Un onglet du « 🪙 Convertisseur d’autrefo: A tab of the « 🪙 Old-time converter ».
Un onglet du dossier et un raccourci dan: A tab of the file and a shortcut in 👥 Heirs
Un onglet que tu crées arrive au bout du: A tab you create goes to the end of the menu; the order you have already set does not move.
Un ou plusieurs nombres : combien de per: One or more numbers: how many people, events, places… match your criteria.
Un pack par continent (NOAA GHCN-Daily): One pack per continent (NOAA GHCN-Daily): each day, temperatures, rain and snow from the longest series. Where stations are rare, the nearest up to 150 km.
Un passage décrit ne peut pas contenir d: A described passage can’t contain a chapter: choose a chapter.
Un passage décrit sert à retrouver ce qu: A described passage helps you find what’s in the collection; “👤” on person records is still possible from the Workshop.
un PDF ne se transforme pas en texte mod: a PDF cannot be turned into editable text here: open the Transcription workshop to copy it out
a PDF cannot be turned into editable text here: open Record transcription to copy it out
Un PDF sobre, une source pour chaque lie: A plain PDF, a source for each link
Un peintre est peut-être passé dans son: A painter may have passed through their village: French museums describe their paintings on POP
Un pense-bête, une citation, une consign: A reminder, a quote, an instruction, with emojis.
Un pense-bête, une citation… Les émojis: A reminder, a quote… Emojis work 🌳
Un personnage de {a} s’appelle {n} : {c}: A character by {a} is called {n}: {c}, in « {w} »{y}.
Un petit diagramme par groupe, côte à cô: One small diagram per group, side by side, with the same scale to compare at a glance.
Un petit fichier à envoyer à un cousin :: A small file to send to a cousin: they click the faces and write who it is
A short film with your photos and videos.
Un petit graphique dans la case : \"cour: A small chart in the cell: "courbe" (line), "barres" (bars) or "gagné" (above or below zero).
Un petit graphique dans la case, qui sui: A small chart in the cell that follows the figures. Several rows selected: one chart per row (the range moves down with them).
un petit message en bas de l’écran: a small message at the bottom of the screen
Un petit portrait au début de chaque lig: A small portrait at the start of each row
Un petit programme qui télécharge et fai: A small program that downloads and runs AI models with one command. It is the one LCNDA installs and uses by default.
Un petit récit d’un jour de sa vie : âge: A short story of one day in their life: age, family, village, occupation, calendar, weather, context
Un petit titre en capitales posé sur un: A small title in capitals sitting on a line. Plain, takes little room.
un petit ver des galeries humides donnai: a small worm in damp tunnels gave some people « miners’ anaemia », also called tunnel or brickmakers’ anaemia.
Un petit verre les soirs de fête : le mo: A little glass on festive evenings: morale holds up much better.
Un peu « bureau » : moins de caractère q: A bit “office-like”: less character than the others.
Un peu d’arrondi adoucit le carré sans l: A little rounding softens the square without making it a circle. Only for the “Rounded square” shape. Double-click the slider: default value.
Un peu moins « cliquable » au premier re: A little less “clickable” at first sight.
Un peu plus haute ; le bas de la case es: A little taller; the bottom of the box is narrower.
Un peu plus lent que d’habitude (80 à 90: A little slower than usual (80 to 90%) is easier to follow.
Un pion devient <b>dame</b> s’il <b>term: A man becomes a king if it ends its move on the last row (if it only passes through during a multiple capture, it stays a man).
Un pion qui arrive sur la dernière ligne: A man reaching the last row becomes a king (the move ends there). The king moves forwards and backwards one square.
Un plan d’architecte dessine souvent cha: An architect’s plan often draws each wall with two lines: keep a small thickness, or untick the furniture, dimension and hatching layers.
Un plan exporté d’ici : ses murs sont re: A plan exported from here: its walls are taken by their axis (MURS_AXES).
Un plan tout fait (titre, titre et texte: A ready-made plan (title, title and text, full-page photo…): texts already written are kept and move.
un poêle, un court-circuit… un 🧯 extinct: a stove, a short circuit… a 🧯 fire extinguisher puts it out at once
Un point de recombinaison à la position: A recombination point at the “From” position
Un point par génération d’ancêtres (la m: One point per generation of ancestors (the average of the birthplaces), linked by an arrow
Un point par personne : en colonnes (par: One dot per person: in columns (by decade, by century…), coloured (by sex, by name…).
Un point par personne : on compte vraime: One dot per person: real counting, group by group.
Un point rapide sur la base, les dates q: A quick look at the database, upcoming dates, recent changes and work to follow up.
Un point, au rayon ci-dessous: A point, at the radius below
un portrait refait avec tous les autres: a portrait rebuilt from all the others
Un portrait, trois prénoms : il faut tro: One portrait, three first names: find the right one. You need at least three portraits.
Un prénom du calendrier républicain ou d: A first name from the Republican calendar or from the time of the Revolution.
Un prénom qui « saute » une génération :: A name that “skips” a generation: the child gets it from a grandparent (or great-grandparent), though neither father nor mother bore it. The popularity of each name in France (INSEE) is in Heritage → First names.
Un profil = un nom + une icône + une cou: A profile = a name + an icon + a colour + sections (reused or yours) + a starting order.
Un quadrillage bleu en kilomètres (ou mè: A blue grid in kilometers (or meters) helps you draw at the right distances; it’s never printed.
Un questionnaire « Te souviens-tu de… »: A “Do you remember…” questionnaire that a relative fills in at home; their answers come back as testimonies.
un rappel avec un lien vers chacune: a reminder with a link to each
Un rattachement de la source n’existe pl: A link of the source no longer exists.
A link of the media item no longer exists.
Un récit dicté ou collé : les naissances: A dictated or pasted story: the births, marriages, occupations and homes picked out, compared with the tree, to add in one click.
A collection keeps at least one version.
Un recueil ne peut pas être son propre a: A collection can’t be its own other copy.
Un recueil rassemble des pages photograp: A collection gathers pages photographed in order: a register, a list of prisoners, a notebook, an album. You can transcribe each page, keep several photo campaigns (those from ten years ago and the new ones) and choose the best image page by page.
Un recueil se fait avec des images (phot: A collection is made of images (page photos): none of these documents is one.
Un registre publié en ligne (IIIF) : ses: A register published online (IIIF): its images downloaded into a new collection
un réglage « {name} » existe déjà : choi: a setting “{name}” already exists: choose another name
Un réglage « {name} » existe déjà. Quel: A setting “{name}” already exists. What name should this one have?
Un réglage de {what}, exporté ici ou sur: A setting from {what}, exported here or on another computer (file “lcnda-reglage-….json”).
Un réglage s’appelle déjà « {name} ». No: A setting is already called “{name}”. Name of the imported setting:
Un réglage s’appelle déjà « {name} ». Qu: A setting is already called “{name}”. What name for this one?
un relais de poste connu sur la route: a known post relay on the route
Un relevé publié (par exemple sur data.g: A published abstract (for example on data.gouv.fr)
Un repère : sa place en % (x = depuis la: A marker: its position in % (x = from the left, y = from the top). Tip: click the image in the preview to read the position.
One result per column of the range.
One result per row of the range.
Un rond de la couleur du plus fréquent: A dot in the colour of the most frequent
Un ronflement du courant a été trouvé ({: A mains hum was found ({n} Hz): it is removed, along with the clicks. Listen to the difference.
Un rush du projet n’est pas un média de: A clip in the project isn’t a media item from the database.
Un salon, un forum, une journée portes o: A fair, a forum, an archives open day: the date, the place, what to bring.
Un seul canal : l’encre ferro-gallique r: A single channel: iron gall ink often stands out better on red or blue
Un seul département en 1790 (coupé en de: A single département in 1790 (split in two from 1793 to 1811, then in 1976).
Un seul dessin partout, à la couleur du: One look everywhere, in the colour of the gender: man, woman, animal can be told apart at a glance.
Un seul fichier .html : aucune requête,: A single .html file: no requests, nothing to install. Put it on the phone (cable, AirDrop, Android sharing, an e-mail to yourself); it works in flight mode.
Un seul fichier à envoyer par e-mail ; i: A single file to send by email; they fill it in at home and send you back their answers.
Un seul fichier CSV avec toutes les sect: A single CSV file with all sections: people, events, media, change log. Each section is marked by a ## NAME header.
Un seul fichier HTML, qui s’ouvre dans n: A single HTML file that opens in any browser, without the app: to send by email or put in the cloud. Removed, along with the sentences that name them: living or probably living people (same rule as the GEDCOM “For sharing” export), confidential records. Record numbers are not included.
Un seul jeu : les As sont posés d’avance: A single deck: the Aces are placed in advance, 10 columns of 4 face-up cards. Build down in suit and move whole runs; the stock goes through only once.
A single deck: the Aces are placed in advance, 7 columns of 3 face-up cards. Build down in suit and move whole runs; the stock can be gone through as often as you like.
Un seul jeu, 7 colonnes de 3 cartes (deu: One deck, 7 columns of 3 cards (two face down), spider rules.
Un seul jeu, 9 colonnes de 4 cartes (deu: One deck, 9 columns of 4 cards (two face down). Build down regardless of suit and move whole runs; the stock goes through only once.
Un seul jeu, tout est visible en 10 colo: One deck, everything visible in 10 columns (8, 8, 8, 7… 1), no stock: spider rules.
Un seul métier et ses variantes: A single occupation and its variants
Un seul parent du défunt est dans la bas: Only one parent of the deceased is in the database: the other branch remains to be searched.
Un seul parent noté : relie sa fiche à s: Only one parent recorded: link their record to their other parent (full or half-sibling).
Un seul parent, sans frère ni sœur, mais: One parent only, no brother or sister, but ascendants in the other branch: half to the parent, half to these ascendants (art. 738-1).
Un seul registre : numérotation continue: One register: continuous numbering even if the cases are in several genealogies. Switching from one to the other would restart from another counter (duplicate numbers): this choice is locked as soon as the first invoice is issued.
Un seul registre pour le cabinet: A single register for the practice
un seul véhicule par sortie, le meilleur: one vehicle per trip, the best for the terrain
Un site général, à essayer: A general site, worth a try
Un site qui n’est pas dans la liste : so: A site not in the list: its search address, with in place of what you’re looking for
Un soir = une fiche : la date, le lieu,: One evening = one record: the date, the place, the setlist (titles, encores, covers, guests), who was on stage and in the audience.
Un sommaire ou un index ne peut pas rece: A table of contents or an index can’t receive the rest of a text.
Un sommet de la zone n’a pas de coordonn: A corner of the area has no valid coordinates.
A corner of the area isn’t readable.
Un son de la base ou de l’ordinateur, à: A sound from the database or the computer, to work on and keep as a project
Un son de la base, nettoyé en deux minut: A sound from your database, cleaned up in two minutes
Un son de tes médias (témoignage, chanso: A sound from your media (testimony, song…), and what can be heard written below it if you like
Un son, une vidéo ou une photo (facultat: A sound, a video or a photo (optional)
Un Sosa impair est une mère : le sexe de: An odd Sosa number is a mother: check the record’s sex, or its place in the tree.
Un Sosa pair est un père : le sexe de la: An even Sosa number is a father: check the record’s sex, or its place in the tree.
Un sous-titre de 3 s à la tête de lectur: A 3 s subtitle at the playhead, on the “Subtitles” track
Un souvenir (une odeur, un bruit), une r: A memory (a smell, a sound), a recipe, a song, a letter for later, a recorded interview… everything is kept in the ✨ Treasures tab.
A style already has this name.
Un suivi de registre choisi n’existe plu: A chosen register tracking no longer exists.
Un sujet ou un nom : les livres qui en p: A subject or a name: the books about it.
Un tableau à remplir (des noms et des ch: A table to fill in (names and figures, in one or more series), pasted from a spreadsheet or imported from a CSV file.
un tableau avec sa source (1 élément): a table with its source (1 item)
Un tableau avec une ligne de titres : Pr: A table with a header row: First name, Surname, Email, Phone, Address, Postcode, Town, Answer (yes / no / maybe), Number, Diet, Note.
Un tableau d’inventaire (copier-coller d: An inventory table (copy-paste from a spreadsheet)
Un tableau dans le tableau : double-clic: A board within the board: double-click to go into it.
Un tableau des musées de France représen: A painting in French museums depicts {c}: {t}{w} ({d}).
Un tableau libre pour cette recherche :: A free board for this research: notes, arrows, photos, records… You can make several (one “part” each).
Un tableau posé à droite du plan : chaqu: A table to the right of the plan: each room and its area, and the total. It updates itself and goes with the plan (image, PDF, print).
Un tampon par village de l’arbre : quand: A stamp for each village in the tree: when you go there, it fills with colour. How many have you visited?
Un test par personne et par société : ty: One test per person and per company: type, haplogroups, estimated origins, markers.
Un testament, un partage, un inventaire: A will, a division, a probate inventory, a donation, a dowry: note the deceased (or the donor), the heirs, and what each received.
Un texte du Traitement de texte (une let: A text from the Word processor (a letter, a story), tidied up for the page
Un texte en cours, avec ses mots comptés: A text in progress, with a word count
Un texte par page : la lecture rapide et: One text per page: quick reading and printed-text reading work page by page; deep reading can read all pages.
Un texte peut continuer d’un bloc à l’au: A text can continue from one block to another, on other pages: it moves on by itself when the first is full.
Un texte posé dans un coin, au milieu ou: A text placed in a corner, in the middle or repeated.
Un texte, un son ou une vidéo qui ne s’o: A text, a sound or a video that only opens on a set date: “for Léa’s 18th birthday”, “in 2050”.
Un thème règle les couleurs de toute l’a: A theme sets the colours of the whole app: the main colour, the background of the page, panels, cards and their headers, the text, and the surrounding lines (colour and thickness). Create your own from an existing theme: it is added to the “Preset” list, under “✎ My themes”.
un timbre dans le coin, filet pointillé: a stamp in the corner, dotted rule
a dash typed by mistake before the year.
Un titre par ligne, avec si tu veux la p: One title per line, optionally with the position in front and the duration at the end: “A1. Paris canaille 2:41”.
Un titre pour séparer les parties: A heading to separate the parts
Un titre, une note, une consigne ou un p: A title, a note, an instruction or a reminder, with emojis.
Un toit par aile (maison en L, en T, en: One roof per wing (L-, T-, U-shaped house)
Un toit sur l’étage le plus haut: A roof on the top floor
un trait bleu à gauche: a blue line on the left
Un trait épais ressemble aux traits noir: A thick line looks like the app’s black lines; a thin line is more elegant. Only for line icons.
Un trait vers la vraie place quand une f: A line to the real place when a shape has moved
Un très léger grain qui évite les « marc: A very light grain that avoids visible “steps” in soft gradients.
Un triangle : chaque point a trois parts: A triangle: each point has three parts (for example farming, crafts, trade); the closer it is to a corner, the bigger that part.
Un trou couvert de branches devant la tr: A hole covered with branches in front of the hatch: raiders fall in.
un type de champ (text, email, date, num: a field type (text, email, date, number…)
Un vélo avec une grande caisse : +14. Ma: A bike with a big box: +14. Poor in mud and snow.
Un verrou à l’ouverture de « {name} », s: A lock when opening “{name}”, on this computer and on the others.
Un vide à l’étage le plus bas : il n’ouv: An open space on the lowest floor: it opens onto nothing
An open space at least 40 cm on each side.
Un village, une maison : qui y a vécu, d: A village, a house: who lived there, from when to when, generation after generation.
Un village, une ville, une région: A village, a town, a region
Un volcan a-t-il gâché les récoltes cett: Did a volcano ruin the harvests that year?
Une « pièce » = une source citée sur l’a: A “document” = a source cited on the record (two copies of the same record count as one); a “proved” proof case counts as one more.
Une <b>version</b> est une série de phot: A version is a series of photos of the same document: those taken ten years ago, those from your next visit… They coexist. For each page, you choose the image to keep (⭐): it’s “the best version”, made of the best of each. A photo can also be a detail (zoom) of a page.
une absence qui parle (pas d’acte là où: a telling absence (no record where there should be one)
Une action en double : seule la dernière: A duplicate action: only the last card counts for “Rename” and “Change format”
Une action enregistrée dans la Retouche: An action saved in Photo retouching (File → Actions), on each image.
An action saved in Photo retouching, applied to each image of the batch.
Une action garde les réglages de la phot: An action keeps the photo’s adjustments (exposure, levels, curve, hue, filters, dust, colourisation…) and its adjustment layers without a mask. You apply it to another photo, or to several at once: each gets a new version, the original is kept.
Une adresse commence par https:// ou mai: An address starts with https:// or mailto:
Une adresse de téléchargement ne venait: A download address didn’t come from an expected source: nothing was kept.
Une adresse de tuiles (https://…/{z}/{x}: A tile address (https://…/{z}/{x}/{y}.png) from a site that allows it, with no key
Une adresse doit commencer par http:// o: An address must start with http:// or https://
Une adresse IMDb de la personne (nm…): An IMDb address for the person (nm…)
Une adresse qui commence par https:// (o: An address starting with https:// (or mailto:).
Une adresse, une ferme, une maison : tou: An address, a farm, a house: everything you have on this place. Groups the same address in the same commune (ignoring spelling differences) and nearby GPS points.
Une aide pour décider, pas une preuve :: A help to decide, not a proof: look at the sources too.
Une ancienne commune y a été réunie : {n: A former town was merged into it: {n}{y}.
une année d’aujourd’hui ou d’avant (jusq: a year from today or earlier (up to 2025)
Une année de la famille au hasard, chaqu: A random family year, every day
une année entre 1300 et 2025 (exemples :: a year between 1300 and 2025 (examples: 1780, an X, 1955)
Une année par ligne : « 1793 : 512 », «: One year per line: “1793: 512”, “1806 1 203”; a former name: “1793: Montagne-sur-Loire”
une année seule compte si toute l’année: a year on its own counts if the whole year is within the period
A quiet year in the family.
Une application avec une interface, qui: An app with an interface that downloads and runs models (GGUF, and MLX on Apple Silicon Macs) and serves them to LCNDA through an “OpenAI-compatible” API.
Une autre base a été installée entre-tem: Another database was installed in the meantime.
Une autre commune « {name} » est beaucou: Another town called “{name}” is much closer to the rest of the family ({a} km instead of {b} km): département {dep}
Une autre époque de la maison en fantôme: Another period of the house as a ghost (the 🕰 layer’s, otherwise the previous period): very transparent walls, dotted edges
Une autre fenêtre a enregistré ce docume: Another window saved this document in the meantime. Keeping your version will erase the other one.
Une autre fenêtre a enregistré ce site e: Another window saved this site in the meantime. Keeping your version will erase theirs.
Une autre fiche porte le même nom: Another record has the same name
Une autre généalogie a été ouverte dans: Another family tree was opened in another window: reload the page.
Une autre image à la même place, même ta: Another image in the same place, same size, same rotation
Une autre vie aurait été possible… mais: Another life would have been possible… but this is the one that led to you.
Une balise ou un collier GPS ? Importe s: A GPS tag or collar? Import its file (GPX, KML, CSV).
Une bande de la couleur principale (cell: A band in the main colour (the one from Appearance), title in white.
une bande de moins sur les routes: one gang fewer on the roads
Une bande en dehors du fond perdu pour l: A strip outside the bleed for notes to the printer (title, date); it only prints with the crop marks.
Une bande par personne, colorée selon la: One band per person, coloured by the town (or county, country) where they lived at each period.
Une barre courte ; des recettes en un cl: A short bar; one-click recipes and the other settings in the “🎚️ See better” panel, in three sections
Une barre courte ; les autres réglages d: A short bar; the other settings in the “🎚️ See better” panel, in three sections
Une barre de la naissance au décès ; les: One bar from birth to death; ongoing or unknown lives as dotted lines.
Une barre par personne, de sa naissance: One bar per person, from birth to death (or to today).
One bar per person, from birth to death.
Une barre par vie : on voit qui a vécu e: One bar per life: see who lived at the same time.
Une base professionnelle « ⚖️ Dossiers d: A professional database “⚖️ Estate files”, created in 🌳 My family trees. All your files are there together; your family stays separate.
Une base propre : « Laboureur », « labou: A clean database: “Laboureur”, “laboureur”, “labour.” and “Labourreur” become a single spelling. Nothing changes without your consent: choose the spelling to keep, untick what must not change, then confirm.
Une battue suit commune par commune les: A search sweep tracks, town by town, the registers already consulted.
Une bonne cuisine fait durer les réserve: Good cooking makes supplies last: 2 extra rations a day with 1 plant (twice as many with a cook).
une bonne réponse donne un seul lancer b: a right answer gives one bonus roll
Une bonne réponse donne un seul lancer b: A right answer gives one bonus roll.
Une bougie pour un ancêtre, avec un mot: A candle for an ancestor, with a note: it burns for seven days. Upcoming birth and death anniversaries.
Une branche de la famille — partagée par: A branch of the family — shared by the family
